description: Run a single-statement SELECT against the df_<id> dataframes staged by ilostat_query_indicator and ilostat_compare_geographies or stored by an earlier register_as. Inspect a dataframe with ilostat_dataframe_describe first; its column schema is what the SQL has to match. Read-only: writes, DDL, DROP, COPY, PRAGMA, ATTACH, file references, file-reading table functions, and functions that read engine settings or name a table from a string are rejected, and system catalogs (information_schema, pg_catalog, sqlite_master, duckdb_*) are denied. Breakdown versions overlap (AGE_YTHADULT_*, AGE_AGGREGATE_*, AGE_10YRBANDS_*, AGE_5YRBANDS_*; ECO_SECTOR_*, ECO_AGGREGATE_*, ECO_ISIC4_*, ECO_ISIC3_*), so filter to one version before summing. Optional register_as stores the result as a new dataframe with a fresh TTL.

preview.description: Rows returned inline; defaults to row_limit, and a larger value is applied as row_limit. Inline rows also stop at a size budget (applied_limits.preview_chars). Set lower when register_as keeps the full result.

register_as.description: Store the result as a new dataframe under this name (df_XXXXX_XXXXX: letters and digits, five in each part; stored uppercased after df_) with a fresh TTL, to chain analyses. A result over 1,000,000 rows is refused, and storing one can evict the oldest dataframes, which evicted names.

row_limit.description: Cap on rows materialized; defaults to 1,000, or the per-call cap when that is lower. The per-call cap is 10,000, or the lower cap the deployment sets; a larger value, up to 1,000,000, is applied as that cap. A query matching more stops at the cap and row_count_capped is true; register_as keeps the full result.

sql.description: One SELECT over df_<id> tables (DuckDB SQL: joins, aggregates, window functions, CTEs), at most 20,000 characters. BIGINT results such as COUNT or SUM of integers serialize as strings; CAST to DOUBLE for inline arithmetic.

name: ilostat_dataframe_query

applied_limits.description: The limits this call ran under, after any clamp.

preview.description: Inline rows applied: preview, at most the applied row_limit.

preview_chars.description: Inline size budget applied, in characters; rows stop before the first that would pass it.

row_limit.description: Row cap applied: row_limit (default 1,000), or the per-call cap when that is lower. With register_as it bounds the inline rows, never the stored result.

cap.description: The row cap that bound: preview when lower than row_limit, else row_limit.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `canvas_unavailable`: The DataCanvas DuckDB engine cannot load in this deployment. `system_catalog_access`: The SQL references a system catalog. `missing_table`: A referenced df_<id> does not exist or has expired. `invalid_sql`: The SELECT fails to prepare: an unknown column or an invalid expression. `sql_execution_error`: The SELECT prepared but failed on the data. `register_as_clash`: register_as names an existing dataframe. `register_as_too_large`: The register_as result holds more than 1,000,000 rows. `non_select_statement`: The SQL is not a SELECT. `multi_statement`: The SQL holds more than one statement, or a PIVOT with no IN list, which DuckDB expands into several. `denied_function`: The SQL calls a file-reading or external table function, a function that reads engine settings (current_setting, current_schema, which an unqualified column of that name also reads as), or one that runs SQL or names a table from a string (query_table, query() over anything but one string literal, query() nested more than 4 deep). `sql_read_only`: The SQL names a file in place of a table, or attempts a write the engine refuses. `plan_operator_not_allowed`: The plan uses an operator outside the read-only allowlist, such as range(). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

evicted.description: Dataframes dropped, oldest first, to keep this tenant within 1,000,000 staged rows and 100 dataframes; present only when storing the result evicted any.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 expiry of the new dataframe.

notice.description: Guidance when the query returned no rows, a cap withheld some, or a limit was applied below the value sent.

registered_as.description: The new dataframe name, when register_as stored the result.

row_count.description: Rows the query produced. With register_as this is the exact count of the stored dataframe, which row_limit does not bound; otherwise at most row_limit, and when row_count_capped is true it is the cap, not a total.

row_count_capped.description: True when the query matched more rows than row_limit; never true with register_as, which stores every row.

rows.description: Result rows keyed by the names in columns, bounded by preview, row_limit, and an inline size budget; rows stop before the first that would pass the budget, and a value is never clipped. BIGINT values arrive as strings.

truncated.description: True when a cap withheld rows from this response.

title: Query staged ILOSTAT dataframes
